ai-dashboard.title: AI Dashboard
ai-dashboard.summary: Management dashboard for a specialty coffee shop: sales, orders and stock on one screen, plus a weekly summary written by Claude that prints out like a café receipt.
ai-dashboard.problem: A small café has its sales in the point-of-sale system, but nobody looks at them: there's no time to cross-check peak hours, growing products and stock. The goal was a dashboard you understand in five seconds that, beyond showing numbers, tells you what to do this week. As a portfolio project, it also had to open in one click, with no sign-up.
ai-dashboard.decisions: Built with Next.js and TypeScript, with the data in Firebase. Instead of reading thousands of orders, I store one summary per day, so the dashboard loads fast and costs less. The AI is called from the server: the key never reaches the browser and every response is checked before it's shown. To keep costs under control, the summary is generated once a week and there's a daily usage limit per person. The sample data refreshes itself every hour, so the dashboard always shows today. Custom design, in Spanish and English, and accessible.
ai-dashboard.result: Live on Vercel, with automatic deploys from GitHub. Lighthouse: 100 in accessibility, best practices and SEO, and 99 desktop performance; mobile is around 75 and is the next thing to improve. Main takeaways: plan for what happens when something fails (if the AI doesn't respond, the dashboard still shows a summary), and test in production, because several issues only showed up after deploying, not on my machine.

paragraphs.intro: I'm a Systems Analyst focused on frontend development with React, TypeScript and Next.js. I enjoy building clear, fast and accessible interfaces, and caring about every detail from design to deploy.
paragraphs.industry: I'm also studying Industrial Maintenance at a technical college, because I'm drawn to where software meets industry: automation, Industry 4.0 and tools that help companies make better use of their data.
paragraphs.ai: I use AI tools like Claude Code every day to code, document and learn faster, while making sure I understand every part of the code I ship.
paragraphs.looking: I'm looking for my first job in tech, either remote or on-site in Mar del Plata, and I'm open to all kinds of opportunities. I'm eager to join a team, keep learning and grow professionally.
